library(tidyverse)

setwd("/Users/cmdb/qb26-answers/week1") 

header <- c("chr", "start", "end", "count")

dfB <- read_tsv("hg16-kc-count.bed", col_names = header)
dfA <- read_tsv("hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names = header)

combined <- bind_rows(hg19 = dfA, hg16 = dfB, .id = "assembly")

ggplot(combined, aes(x = start, y = count, color = assembly)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales = "free")

ggsave( "exercise2.png" )
